details.description: Arno Pert Cool Breeze Air Freshener is a long-lasting aerosol spray that instantly eliminates bad odours and fills indoor spaces with a refreshing floral fragrance, ideal for homes, offices, cars, hotels, and washrooms. It distributes fragrance evenly through an easy-spray mechanism, creating a clean and pleasant environment. It is suitable for daily use to refresh living rooms, kitchens, bedrooms, and commercial spaces. Made with solvents, fragrance, and propellant, it offers premium freshness with simple usage—just shake well and spray in short bursts while keeping the can upright.
details.usageInstructions: Hold the can upright about 20 cm from the area and press the nozzle for 2-3 seconds. Use in a ventilated room.
details.dangerWarnings: Flammable aerosol. Do not spray near flame, heat or on a burning object. Do not puncture or burn the can even when empty. Avoid contact with eyes and do not inhale the spray. Keep away from children and pets. Store below 50 C.
